(async () => { const a = await (async () => { const G = window.G; let n = 0; const t = performance.now(); await new Promise(r => { const f = () => { n++; if (performance.now() - t < 3000) requestAnimationFrame(f); else r(); }; requestAnimationFrame(f); }); const i = G.renderer.info.render; return JSON.stringify({ q: G.opts.quality, fps: +(n / 3).toFixed(1), calls: i.calls, tri: i.triangles, stuecke: G.STR ? G.STR.stuecke : null, belag: G.STR ? G.STR.belagOk : null }); })(); return a + ' ' + (() => { const G = window.G, p = G.player.pos; const out = []; for (const [, t] of G.TILES) for (const r of (t.data && t.data.roads) || []) for (let i = 0; i < r.p.length - 1; i++) { const [ax, az] = r.p[i], [bx, bz] = r.p[i + 1]; const dx = bx - ax, dz = bz - az, L = dx * dx + dz * dz || 1, tt = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((p.x - ax) * dx + (p.z - az) * dz) / L)); if (Math.hypot(p.x - ax - dx * tt, p.z - az - dz * tt) < 12) { out.push({ n: r.n, w: r.w, l: r.l, o: r.o, so: G.STR.sorte(r) }); break; } } return JSON.stringify({ stat: G.STR.STAT, dbg: G.STR.dbg, roads: out.slice(0, 6) }); })(); })()
